title: Seattle on Foot to the Night Train
summary: A full Seattle day on foot from Belltown, then bags, bus to the station, and the 6pm train to Vancouver.

segments.name: Segment 1 — Pike Place Market on foot
segments.blurb: 8-10 minute walk from the Belltown Airbnb.

stops.name: Beecher's Handmade Cheese
stops.note: Mac and cheese, cheese made on-site.

stops.name: Gum Wall
stops.note: Post Alley wall covered in chewed gum.

expect.arrive: 8-10 min walk from Belltown; market opens early and is already busy with vendors by 8:30am, before tour groups arrive.
expect.parking: Walk from the Belltown Airbnb, no transit needed.

paths.do: Stay under the market's covered arcades (Main and North Arcade) the whole time; Post Alley and the Gum Wall are also covered.
Cover the main arcades, Post Alley, Gum Wall, and the waterfront side stalls below.

segments.name: Segment 2 — Pioneer Square
segments.blurb: About 25 minutes on foot from the market.

stops.name: Klondike Gold Rush National Historical Park
stops.q: Klondike Gold Rush National Historical Park Seattle
stops.note: Free museum on the 1897 gold rush.

expect.arrive: About 25 min on foot from the market, downhill then flat; Pioneer Square is quiet mid-morning, mostly local foot traffic.
expect.parking: Walk from Pike Place, no transit needed.

paths.do: Klondike Gold Rush museum is free and indoors; linger there, then a quick look at the Pioneer Square buildings from under awnings.
Museum, wander the square's ironwork storefronts, then Salumi for lunch (expect a short queue; cash only).

alt: Klondike Gold Rush National Historical Park Seattle interior

segments.name: Segment 3 — Seattle Center and Chihuly Garden and Glass
segments.blurb: Back toward Belltown; collect bags after this.

stops.name: Chihuly Garden and Glass
stops.note: Dale Chihuly glass sculpture garden and galleries.

stops.name: Belltown
stops.note: Walk back to the Airbnb, collect bags.

expect.arrive: Seattle Center is a 15-20 min walk or a short bus/monorail ride from Pioneer Square; Chihuly Garden and Glass is fully indoor/glasshouse so it's a good rainy-afternoon stop.
expect.parking: Monorail from Westlake Center (2 min ride) or walk from downtown.

paths.do: Chihuly Garden and Glass galleries and glasshouse, skip the Space Needle, walk back to Belltown to collect bags.
Chihuly first, then Space Needle observation deck (book a timed slot in advance), then walk back for bags.

segments.seasonal: Monday hours: Chihuly Garden and Glass 10:30am-6:30pm; Space Needle 10:30am-8:00pm. Both open on Mondays, no weekday closure to plan around.
segments.cost: Chihuly Garden and Glass adult admission is about $40-45 USD (chihulygardenandglass.com, read 2026-09-12). Space Needle adult admission ranges $35-55 USD depending on time/season, with timed entry every 15 min (spaceneedle.com, read 2026-09-12) - book ahead, especially for a specific arrival window.

segments.name: Segment 4 — King Street Station and the 6:00 PM train
segments.blurb: Bus or Uber to the station, then Amtrak north.

stops.name: Wall St & 5th Ave bus stop
stops.note: 16 min bus to the station, every 15 min.

stops.name: Pacific Central Station, Vancouver
stops.note: Arrive 10:00pm; Canadian border check on arrival.

expect.arrive: Bags in hand from Belltown; bus stop at Wall St & 5th Ave has frequent service, or a 10-15 min Uber/taxi in light traffic.
expect.parking: Bus from Wall St & 5th Ave (16 min, every 15 min) or rideshare direct to King Street Station.

paths.do: Wall St & 5th Ave bus to King Street Station; buses have limited luggage space at busy times.
Uber/Lyft direct to the station door, easiest with two bags in the rain.

segments.seasonal: Arrive by 5:00pm for the 6:00pm departure (Amtrak recommends 45 min before departure to check bags, more time if queues are long). Canadian customs/border check happens on arrival at Pacific Central Station in Vancouver around 10:00pm, not before boarding in Seattle.
